metric_evidence.design_coherence: Observed across all 34 captures. Shared navigation, restrained cyan/blue accents, borders, buttons and dark-mode surfaces form a coherent professional system. Remaining inconsistency includes Claude versus Anthropic naming across Providers and OAuth Login, plus duplicated OAuth-rule navigation on Auth Files.
metric_evidence.typography: Page titles, section headings and numeric summaries are clearly differentiated. Monospace identifiers suit technical content. Logs, quota legends and secondary metadata use notably small text; the long quota legend strings require more reading effort than the surrounding summaries.
metric_evidence.cleanliness: Most screens are calm and task-focused, without decorative distractions. Providers and Quick Start remain appropriately sparse. Quota repeats account identity and percentage across the summary list, boxed legends and breakdown; Config adds several nested border layers.
metric_evidence.visual_design: Neutral surfaces, controlled accents and consistent iconography fit developer operations. Dark mode preserves the same visual hierarchy. Quota's diagonal hatching, dashed lines, grid and boxed legends create a visibly busier treatment than the otherwise restrained interface.
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Visible searches, filters, contextual add actions and Quick Start links support direct task entry. Remaining friction includes the unlabeled enabled switches on mobile Auth Files and the mobile alias editor placing substantial setup content before the actual mapping fields. Interaction success was not exercised.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: Desktop headings, status summaries and primary actions are generally well ordered. Usage separates totals from detailed models effectively. On mobile OAuth Model Aliases, the required alias input only begins at the bottom of the viewport after introductory and provider-selection content. Mobile Plugin Store gives two warning panels substantial prominence before browsing controls.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Desktop tables, card edges and form columns align consistently. Mobile controls generally retain comfortable separation. Quota leaves a comparatively large gap between its collapsed filter and view controls, while mobile alias setup consumes considerable vertical space before editable content.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: Grouped desktop navigation, active indicators, breadcrumbs and mobile parent links clearly establish location. Remaining rough edges are duplicated OAuth-rule entry points on Auth Files and inconsistent Claude/Anthropic naming between configuration and login surfaces. The mobile navigation drawer was not shown.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: Tables become readable cards, provider navigation becomes a select, and action buttons generally expand appropriately. No page-edge overflow is visible; evidence.json also reports none. Remaining issues include truncated dashboard quota legends, unlabeled credential switches and long setup stacks before alias editing. Content below the viewport was not assessed.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Strong primary text, visible form labels, textual statuses and the captured login focus ring are positives. Small chart labels and log text reduce comfortable readability. Mobile credential switches lack an adjacent visible Enabled label, and global utility controls are icon-only. Contrast ratios, hit areas and accessible names were not measured.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Quota shows units, timezone, reset timing, percentages and an explicit explanation for overlapping series. Snapshot and projection language avoids presenting the plot as live consumption. Remaining weaknesses are visually competing hatching and gridlines, lengthy repeated legends and small labels. Missing daily usage data is explicitly explained and is not scored as a production defect.
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Buttons, segmented controls, selects, disclosure arrows and disabled Save states generally communicate action and state well. Provider-specific add labels are especially clear. Mobile Auth Files switches lose the desktop Enabled heading, row menus remain generically labeled Actions, and Remember password does not match the Management Key field.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed readability issue. The quota plots combine diagonal hatching, horizontal gridlines, dashed series and a reset marker. Four long boxed legend entries accompany a single overlapping grey line. Quota Management also repeats those account identities and percentages in an adjacent list.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators must separate several competing visual encodings to read a simple current allowance and reset projection.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Reduce hatch prominence, make the plotted allowance and reset marker dominant, and use compact numbered legend entries. Put full account names and percentages in one authoritative list. Preserve the overlap explanation and explicit projection semantics.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed affordance gap. Each credential card has a prominent switch at its upper-right edge, but the desktop Enabled column label is absent. Requests and Quota retain explicit labels.
top_fixes.user_impact: A mobile operator must infer whether the switch means enabled, healthy or selected before changing a credential's availability.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Add a compact visible Enabled label beside each switch, or pair it with explicit Enabled/Disabled state text. Preserve separation from the selection checkbox.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed hierarchy issue. The alias screen stacks description, disabled Save, prerequisite text, a tall provider card, a second section introduction and another prerequisite message before its mapping fields. The required alias field only begins at the viewport's bottom.
top_fixes.user_impact: The mobile editor gives setup explanation more initial space than the mapping task. This does not establish that below-fold content is inaccessible.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Compact the provider section and consolidate prerequisite messages near its select. Keep Add alias with the mapping controls. Preserve the numbered workflow without repeating the same prerequisite in multiple regions.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed typography issue. Log records, quota reset annotations and legend metadata are substantially smaller than ordinary form and card text. Dark quota labels are additionally muted against a textured plotting area.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators reading timestamps, model identifiers and reset details face a denser, less comfortable reading surface than elsewhere in the product.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Increase diagnostic and chart label sizes modestly, preserve monospace alignment, and strengthen secondary-text contrast. Recover space by shortening repeated legend content rather than shrinking text.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed terminology inconsistency. The credential input is labeled Management Key, while its persistence checkbox says Remember password.
top_fixes.user_impact: The login screen uses two credential terms for the same value, weakening clarity about what is stored.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Rename the checkbox to Remember management key. Preserve the explicit browser-storage explanation.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed consistency issue. Auth Files offers OAuth Model Disablement and OAuth Model Aliases both as top tabs and as lower rule links. Providers uses Claude while OAuth Login leads with Anthropic OAuth.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators encounter redundant destinations and must reconcile provider naming between related workflows.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Use one primary navigation pattern for OAuth rules, retaining lower summaries only when they add distinct information. Use a consistent Claude/Anthropic naming convention across related screens.

top_fixes.evidence: Observed hierarchy tradeoff. The trust notice and disabled-plugin notice occupy roughly the upper third of the viewport before status, search, refresh and filtering controls. Their content is relevant; the empty registry is fixture coverage, not a demonstrated defect.
top_fixes.user_impact: Mobile browsing controls compete with two large explanatory panels.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Keep the trust warning prominent but tighten its wording. Present the global-disabled state as a compact actionable status row, without concealing either consequence.

strengths: All 34 supplied screenshots were inspected directly. Desktop and mobile layouts show a coherent, restrained developer-operations identity.
Desktop navigation has meaningful groups, strong active states and useful breadcrumbs. Mobile subpages retain a visible parent destination.
Providers, Auth Files, Usage and Logs adapt their dense desktop content into readable mobile structures rather than retaining compressed desktop tables.
Quick Start provides concrete task sequencing and direct destinations without unnecessary onboarding decoration.
Operational summaries distinguish collection state, time scope, snapshot freshness, skipped accounts and unavailable data.
Dark mode preserves the established layout and action hierarchy without introducing a separate visual language.
Login explains credential persistence plainly. Plugin warnings name consequential backend access and provide a configuration destination.
unverified: Assessment covers frozen viewport screenshots only, not full-page content or exercised workflows.
No browser state was changed, no captures were run and no files were edited.
Keyboard operation, screen-reader output, accessible names, focus order, target hit areas and measured contrast compliance were not verified.
Search, filtering, sorting, menus, disclosures, mobile navigation, toggles, saving and destructive-action safeguards were not exercised.
Loading, request failures, validation, recovery, unsaved-change protection and completion feedback were not demonstrated by these captures.
Dark mode was inspected only for desktop Dashboard, Providers, Quota and Config. Mobile dark mode and other dark routes remain unverified.
Quota and plugin fixture coverage is partial. Empty plugin results, skipped quota accounts, identical quota series and synthetic metrics are not treated as production defects.
Chart hover behavior, expanded data tables, non-overlapping series and populated daily usage charts were not inspected.
Reduced-motion capture facts do not verify animation behavior or reduced-motion implementation.
Mobbin references were not inspected because authentication was blocked. Comparison uses professional dashboard craft principles, not claimed usability studies or external reference inspection.

metric_evidence.design_coherence: Observed: one consistent shell, grouped sidebar, card/border/button language and near-identical dark-mode layout across dashboard/providers/quota/config. Defect: black primary buttons, outline buttons, beige warning banners, teal login focus ring and tinted provider chips do not read as one token system. Dashboard stat values mix black numerals with grey 'No requests' text at the same level.
metric_evidence.typography: Observed: strong page H1s and tabular numerals in Usage tables and quota percentages. Defect: card titles are only slightly larger/bolder than body text, and timestamps, caveats, axis labels, placeholders and 'Not set / No recent requests' metadata sit in small low-contrast grey across almost every screen. Mono is used well for keys/logs but filenames truncate on mobile quota chips ('7-...').
metric_evidence.cleanliness: Observed: uncluttered cards, honest empty states, no decorative noise. Defect: large dead viewport areas on Providers (one table row), Logs (3 rows), Plugins and Plugin Store, while Quota repeats the same 62% four times in bars, chart legend chips, chart and breakdown table. Auth Files stacks tabs, provider pills, search, status segmented control and View options before any data.
metric_evidence.visual_design: Observed: restrained neutral/blue professional identity fits a developer-operations tool and dark mode preserves it. Defect: uniformly flat white/grey cards with hairline borders give almost no surface hierarchy compared with mature dashboards (Linear/Vercel/Grafana class), and the hatched quota projection area looks dated and visually heavy relative to the single data line it contains.
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Observed: labelled primary actions ('Upload File', 'Add Gemini key', 'Refresh all credentials'), search on Config/OAuth/Plugins, and numbered 01/02 steps on OAuth rule editors. Defect: consequential actions hide behind generic 'Actions' menus, Config shows no visible Save/persistence cue in viewport, OAuth Login lists 9+ undifferentiated providers with no connected/already-authorized status, and disabled Save on OAuth editors explains itself far from the Provider field.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: Observed: clear title > status line > content order on most pages, and Usage leads with four totals. Defect: Dashboard gives equal prominence to 'Requests 0', an empty Success rate and an empty Request flow box, while 'Usage statistics: 129' under Requests 0 is unexplained. Plugin Store warnings outrank the actual (empty) task content. Quota chart area outranks the more readable per-account bars.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Observed: disciplined grids, aligned table columns, right-aligned numeric columns in Usage, consistent card padding and sidebar rhythm in light and dark. Defect: nested cards-inside-cards in Config and Providers add border noise, Quota desktop splits bars and chart awkwardly with legend chips under only the chart half, and mobile filter stacks (Auth Files, Quota View/Window) consume roughly a third of the viewport before content.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: Observed: desktop sidebar grouped as OPERATE/GATEWAY/OBSERVE/CONTROL with clear active pill, Auth Files count badge, and 'CPAMC / Page' breadcrumb plus nested 'Auth Files / OAuth Model Aliases' path. Defect: mobile drops the breadcrumb and group context behind a hamburger, header icon-only controls (refresh, language, theme, logout) duplicate in-page Refresh buttons, and only OAuth subpages show a '< Auth Files' back affordance in the mobile header.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: Observed (390px, no overflow in evidence.json): tables genuinely transform into stacked labelled cards (Providers, Auth Files, Usage, Logs), stat grids become 2x2, and Config section nav becomes a select. Defect: dashboard/quota legend chips truncate account filenames, Auth Files requires scrolling past Section/Provider/search/status controls to reach the first credential, Logs Refresh + Auto toggle is cramped beside the H1, and small desktop type sizes carry over unchanged.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Observed: visible labels on most inputs, text-plus-dot Active status (not color alone), strong login focus ring, and numbered quota series in addition to color. Defect: pervasive small grey secondary text, placeholders and chart axis labels appear below comfortable contrast on white and on dark surfaces; tinted Claude/Codex/Gemini chip text is low contrast; checkboxes, disclosure triangles, 'Details' links and header icon buttons look under 44px touch size; segmented-control selected state relies on a subtle white-on-grey shift.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Observed: per-account quota bars with % and reset time are immediately readable, and Usage tables report requests/tokens/failures/p50/p95 cleanly with honest 'Not reported' handling instead of fake zeros. Defect: the main quota chart draws four overlapping series as one dashed grey line at 62% over a dominant hatched projection field, labelled cryptically '1-4', and needs a 'How to read this chart' disclosure to be interpretable. Request flow and Daily requests render as empty explanatory boxes, so chart coverage is thin outside Quota.
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Observed: toggles, black primary buttons, search fields and segmented controls read clearly as controls. Defect: many controls look like static text: 'Filter accounts', 'How to read this chart', 'View data table', 'Not checked' with chevron in Auth Files quota cells, 'Show provider rules', Quick Start rows (only a trailing chevron hints the row navigates), System model group rows, and the Providers configured list. Generic 'Actions' menus conceal what operations exist.

top_fixes.evidence: Four accounts render as one dashed grey line at 62% over a full-width hatched projection area, annotated '1-4 overlap, drawn as one grey line', with a 'How to read this chart' disclosure underneath. The same values repeat in left bars, legend chips and the Account breakdown table. On mobile the legend chips truncate filenames.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators cannot distinguish accounts, judge burn-down, or tell measured data from projection at a glance. The chart occupies the most space while carrying the least readable information.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Make per-account bars the primary view. If a time chart remains, draw one colored line per account with direct end labels, remove hatching (use a light tint + 'Projection' region label), mark reset with a labelled vertical rule, drop the duplicate legend chips when bars are present, and never truncate account names on mobile (wrap to two lines or list vertically).

top_fixes.evidence: Timestamps, caveat paragraphs, placeholders, table metadata ('No recent requests', 'Not set'), sidebar group labels and chart axes are uniformly small medium-grey text on white or near-black surfaces.
top_fixes.user_impact: Status freshness, caveats about snapshot-vs-live data and secondary values are the hardest content to read, exactly where misreading causes wrong operational conclusions. Likely visible-contrast failures for small text.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Raise secondary text to a token that meets 4.5:1 at its rendered size in both themes, set a 12px floor for metadata and 13px for caveats, and reserve the lightest grey for disabled states only. Verify chip text (Claude/Codex/Gemini tints) against the same ratio.

top_fixes.screen: Auth Files, AI Providers, Quota (mobile); header (all mobile)
top_fixes.evidence: Mobile Auth Files stacks Section select, Provider select, filter input, View options and a 4-part status control before the first credential. Checkboxes, 'Details' links and the four icon-only header buttons render small.
top_fixes.user_impact: On a phone the primary task (check/toggle a credential) starts below a full control stack, and small targets raise mis-tap risk on enable/disable-adjacent controls.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Collapse secondary filters behind one 'Filters' button with an active-count badge on mobile (keep search visible), enforce 44px minimum touch targets for checkboxes, header icons and text controls, and add visible labels or a menu for header icon actions.

top_fixes.evidence: Stat row shows 'Requests 0' with a collapsed 'Usage statistics: 129' line, an equally weighted grey 'No requests' Success rate, and a large empty 'Request flow' card stating 'No requests in this window'.
top_fixes.user_impact: The landing screen appears to contradict itself (0 vs 129) and spends its prime area on absence of data, so connection health and next action are unclear.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Reconcile or label the two request counts inline (e.g. window vs since-restart), demote empty stats to a single muted line, and in the empty Request flow state show the window, last-seen request time if known, and one next action (e.g. link to Quick Start step 4 / Logs).

top_fixes.evidence: No Save/apply control or saved-state indicator is visible in the viewport except 'In sync' in the subtitle. Proxy URL displays 'socks5://user:pass@...' in plaintext (fixture value, but the field treatment is the design issue). Host Address shows placeholder text indistinguishable from a value. Toggle cards nest inside section cards.
top_fixes.user_impact: Users cannot tell whether edits persist automatically or need saving, and credential-bearing fields are exposed on screen/share. Placeholder-as-value ambiguity invites wrong edits.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: State the persistence model at the point of edit (persistent save bar or per-field saved indicator), mask secret-bearing URL credentials with a reveal control like the login key field, style empty fields distinctly from filled ones, and flatten one level of card nesting.

top_fixes.screen: OAuth Login; OAuth Model Disablement / Aliases
top_fixes.evidence: OAuth Login is a long uniform list where every provider has the same outline 'Log in with...' button and no indication of existing credentials. Rule editors show a disabled grey Save top-right on desktop but under the title on mobile, with 'Please enter a provider first' detached from the Provider select.
top_fixes.user_impact: Users cannot see what is already connected and must scan the full list. In the editors the blocking requirement is spatially separated from its field and the primary action moves between breakpoints.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Add per-provider credential status (count/last added, consistent with Auth Files data) and group or sort connected providers first. Anchor the provider-required message directly under the Provider field, and keep Save in one consistent position (e.g. sticky footer/action bar) across widths.

top_fixes.screen: AI Providers, Logs Viewer, Plugins, Plugin Store
top_fixes.evidence: Providers shows one key row then half a viewport of white space, with search/sort/model filter for a single row and 8 providers hidden behind 'Not configured'. Logs shows 3 rows in a full-height box. Plugin pages lead with one or two beige warnings above empty states that offer no next action.
top_fixes.user_impact: Empty/sparse states read as unfinished rather than informative, and users get warnings without a path forward (enable plugins, browse store, add a provider).
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Give each empty state one primary next action (Plugin Store: 'Open plugin setting' is present but Plugins empty state needs 'Browse Plugin Store'; Logs empty area should size to content; Providers should surface not-configured providers as a compact add list and suppress sort/filter chrome below a small row count).

top_fixes.screen: Cross-screen controls (Auth Files, Providers, Quick Start, System, Quota)
top_fixes.evidence: Repeated text-like controls: 'Actions' dropdowns on every row, 'Not checked' chevron inside quota cells, 'Filter accounts', 'How to read this chart', 'View data table', 'Show provider rules', Quick Start rows and System model rows signalled only by a trailing chevron.
top_fixes.user_impact: Discoverability depends on guessing which text is interactive, and the operations inside generic Actions menus are invisible until opened, slowing repeated operator tasks.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Give text controls a consistent link/button treatment (underline or button chrome on the disclosure pattern used once), expose the single most frequent row operation directly beside Actions where space allows, and make whole-row navigation explicit with hover/press states and a labelled destination (Quick Start already names destinations; style them as links).

strengths: Consistent application shell: grouped sidebar (OPERATE/GATEWAY/OBSERVE/CONTROL), active states, breadcrumbs and identical card/button language across all 14 pages and both themes.
Honest data communication: 'reported snapshots, not live usage', 'Not reported' daily usage, snapshot timestamps, GMT-8 labelling and skipped-account counts instead of fabricated zeros.

Real responsive design: tables become labelled stacked cards on mobile (Providers, Auth Files, Usage, Logs), selects replace side navs in Config, and evidence.json reports no horizontal overflow at 390px.
Dark mode parity: dashboard, providers, quota and config preserve layout, status colors and readability structure rather than inverting carelessly.
Clear trust/safety copy in Plugin Store ('Third-party plugins run with full backend access') and login remember-password warning about reversible obfuscation.
Scannable dense tables where it matters: Auth Files credential grid and Usage Top Models with right-aligned numerals, mono identifiers and red failure counts paired with labels.
unverified: Keyboard operation, focus order/visibility beyond the single login focus ring, and screen-reader semantics (roles, labels for icon-only header buttons and toggles).
Hover, pressed, loading, success and error feedback for Refresh, toggles, uploads, OAuth flows and Config edits; whether Config changes auto-save.
Contents and behavior of all dropdowns/menus (Actions, View options, Structured filters, Sort, language), dialogs, toasts and confirmations for destructive actions.
Chart tooltips, crosshair/legend interactivity, and the 'View data table' alternative for the quota chart.
Content below the viewport on every page (screenshots are viewport-only), long-list pagination/virtualization, and behavior with production-scale data volumes.
Motion and reduced-motion behavior (captures used reduced motion), mobile navigation drawer behavior, and in-browser zoom/text scaling.
Quota and plugin states beyond partial fixtures (unsupported quota shapes, installed plugins, non-empty registry) and any live-backend error/offline states.

metric_evidence.design_coherence: The shell, cards, outline buttons, teal active accent and 2px teal tab underline match across screens (pixels sampled: Auth Files and Logs both use #0B7285). There are 4 observed cross-screen breaks. (1) The header-action slot varies. Most pages put Refresh top-right. Plugins and Plugin Store put Refresh in the toolbar row with an empty header. System's 'Check for updates' has no icon. OAuth editors show hint text + Back + Save. (2) Plugin Store stacks 2 amber banners with different treatments: full border with shield icon, then left accent bar with triangle icon. (3) The product has 3 names: 'CLI Proxy API' plus 'CLI Proxy API Management Center' on login, and 'CPAMC / CLI Proxy API Console' in the shell. (4) Dashboard mixes 24h '19:20–22:40 GMT-8' with 12h 'Nov 9, 10:32 PM' on the same screen.
metric_evidence.typography: Sans for prose and mono for IDs, keys, versions and logs is used consistently. Page titles are bold with tight tracking and are distinct. Usage KPI numerals read well. Issues: disclosure markers differ in size (Quota '▸ Filter accounts' is tiny, Dashboard '▶ How to read this chart' is larger). In the OAuth Aliases row, 'Keep original' is bold at about 15px while the field labels beside it are about 13px regular. Config exposes a YAML key in a title ('API Keys List (api-keys)'). Plugin Store tab counts are tiny mono superscript-like zeros. Grey 12-13px meta lines ('Last 3h 20m · current credentials', 'Updated just now · every 60s') are close to the minimum readable weight.
metric_evidence.cleanliness: Little decoration, flat surfaces and restrained borders. Some redundancy. Quota shows the same 4 values 3 times: glance list, legend chips and the Account breakdown table, and the table repeats the file name ('claude-workspace-1.json / Claude · claude-workspace-1.json'). The bottom of Auth Files has an 'OAuth model rules' card that duplicates the tabs at the top. Usage opens with a 2-line explanatory paragraph before any number. Plugin Store shows 2 warning banners before the content.
metric_evidence.visual_design: The practical neutral palette suits an ops console, and dark mode is coherent across all 4 dark captures. Accent use is split: black primary buttons and black 'on' toggles, a teal accent for active and focus states, an amber medium-tone quota bar. The 6 black toggle pills on Auth Files are the heaviest element in the table, more prominent than credential names. The diagonal hatch fills the whole quota plot, adds texture and carries no contrast. The visual identity reads as competent but generic.
metric_evidence.ease_of_use: Primary tasks have direct entry points: Quick Start steps link to their destinations, Providers has a clear 'Add Gemini key', Auth Files has 'Upload File' and per-row Actions, OAuth Login has explicit 'Log in with X' buttons. Friction: Auth Files desktop stacks 3 tab-like rows (section tabs, provider pills, status segmented control) plus 'View options' before the data. The OAuth editors start with Save disabled, and the reason sits in small grey text away from the field it refers to. On Dashboard, 'Requests 0' sits beside an 'Usage statistics: 129' disclosure, which conflicts at a glance.
metric_evidence.information_hierarchy: Page title, meta line and card hierarchy are consistent. On Dashboard the fold is dominated by a quota projection chart and a full-width Request flow card that holds 1 line. No problem or attention summary leads the page, so the operator must read 4 KPI tiles and a chart to learn the state is healthy. Quota repeats data across 3 representations, which splits focus. Auth Files gives filters as much visual weight as the content.
metric_evidence.spacing_alignment: Grid, card padding and 24px-ish section rhythm are consistent. Tables align numbers right (Usage). Observed defects: in the Config Common grid, the 'Switch to Preview Model' title sits about 9px lower than 'Switch Project' in the same row because content is centred vertically. The Dashboard legend chips stop at about x=1053 while the plot runs to about x=1369. The Logs 'Log Content' tab is inset about 11px from the page edge, while the Auth Files 'Credentials' tab is flush. Providers leaves a large empty right column below a single-row table.
metric_evidence.navigation_wayfinding: Strong. The sidebar has OPERATE / GATEWAY / OBSERVE / CONTROL groups, the active state uses a left accent bar plus fill, breadcrumbs are on every desktop page, sub-pages get 'CPAMC / Auth Files / OAuth Model Disablement', mobile sub-pages get a '< Auth Files' back link, and Auth Files carries a count badge. Remaining issues: Plugins and Plugin Store are separate top-level items with overlapping toolbars. OAuth Login is separate from Auth Files, and Auth Files hosts the OAuth rule editors, so the split is not obvious. On mobile, the top bar title repeats the H1 directly below it.
metric_evidence.responsive_mobile: Good adaptations: tabs collapse to Section/Provider selects, tables become cards (Usage, Auth Files, Providers), KPI tiles become a 2x2 grid, and full-width actions appear on Plugins. Observed defects: the action slot moves between screens (beside the H1 on Dashboard, Config and Quota; below a wrapped meta line on Providers; a standalone grey Save above the content on the OAuth editors). The Providers meta line wraps with a dangling '·' at the line end. Dashboard legend chips truncate the limit type ('claude-workspace-1.json · 7-…'), which is the distinguishing detail. The 'Refresh all credentials' label shortens to 'Refresh all', and the Logs label shortens to 'Auto'. Both are intentional, but 'Auto' beside an unlabelled toggle is ambiguous.
metric_evidence.accessibility_visible: Field labels are visible, status uses text plus a dot (not colour alone), the destructive 'Clear login data' is red-outlined with text, and a teal focus ring is visible on Login. Concerns: 4 icon-only top-bar buttons (refresh, globe, sun/moon, logout) have no visible labels. The Account breakdown per-row refresh is a small icon-only button of about 32px. The disabled Save is white on #77797C, measured 4.4:1. That is exempt as a disabled control, but it looks enabled. The hatch texture behind the 1px dashed series line lowers its figure-ground contrast. Number badges 1-4 rely on thin coloured borders.
metric_evidence.data_visualization: Positives: the y-axis is labelled 0-100%, the reset marker is annotated, the timezone is shown, and there are 'How to read this chart' and 'View data table' fallbacks. Explicitly handling overlapping series ('1–4 overlap, drawn as one grey line') is a good choice and is not penalised as a fixture artifact. Fixture-independent defects: (1) the hatch covers the entire plot, so 'Projection →' has nothing to contrast with; (2) the badge colours (teal, green, orange, red) are never used by any line, so the colour key is decorative; (3) the x-ticks are uneven (Dashboard skips Nov 7-8 then labels Nov 9-12; Quota labels Nov 6/9/11/13), and the end ticks repeat a full timestamp; (4) on Quota the 62% amber bars signal caution through the 'medium' tone threshold (confirmed in QuotaGlanceList.tsx) with no legend explaining the tones. Usage has no chart, but that is a fixture limitation ('Not reported').
metric_evidence.interaction_affordance: Buttons, selects, segmented controls, row Actions menus and 'Log in with X' are clearly clickable, and external links carry ↗ icons. Ambiguous affordances: the disabled Save is filled mid-grey and looks like an enabled secondary button. 'Request Logging' on System does not say whether it opens, toggles or navigates. The quota cell 'Not checked ⌄' is a dropdown inside a table cell with weak button styling. The tiny '▸' disclosures are easy to miss. The sun/moon icon shows a state rather than an action. 'Not configured 8 >' on Providers reads as a list row, but its target is unclear.

top_fixes.evidence: Hatch fills the whole plot, the 1-4 badge colours are never used by any line, x-tick density is uneven (Nov 7-8 missing), Dashboard legend chips span only about 2/3 of the plot width, and mobile legend chips truncate the limit type.
top_fixes.user_impact: Operators cannot map a line to an account by colour, and the projection cue does not separate known values from projected ones. When values diverge, which this fixture does not show, the colour key gives no help.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Draw each series in its badge colour (keep grey only for the merged overlap). Hatch only the region past the last snapshot, or remove the hatch. Use regular daily ticks (Nov 7, 8, 9...) with a short date format. Make the legend a full-width grid under the plot, and on mobile wrap legend text instead of truncating it.

top_fixes.evidence: Refresh is top-right on Dashboard, Providers, Auth Files, Usage and Config. It is in the toolbar row on Plugins and Plugin Store. System's 'Check for updates' has no icon. OAuth editors use hint + Back + Save. On mobile the actions sit beside the H1, below the meta line, or as a standalone Save above the content.
top_fixes.user_impact: Users must re-scan each page for its primary action. On mobile the Save on OAuth editors scrolls away from the form it commits.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Define one PageHeader action slot: primary and secondary actions at top-right on desktop, and one consistent mobile rule (an action row below the meta, or a sticky bottom bar for editors with Save). Move the Plugins and Plugin Store refresh into that slot, and give every header button an icon or none.

top_fixes.screen: OAuth Model Disablement, OAuth Model Aliases
top_fixes.evidence: Save is disabled as a filled #77797C button with white text (measured 4.4:1), and the reason 'Please enter a provider first' is small grey text next to Back, or below Save on mobile.
top_fixes.user_impact: Save looks enabled, and the blocking requirement is shown far from the Provider field that resolves it.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Use a low-emphasis disabled style (light fill, muted text, no solid grey block). Move the requirement into the Provider step as helper or validation text. Keep Save adjacent to the form on mobile.

top_fixes.evidence: The fold shows 'Requests 0' beside 'Usage statistics: 129', 'Success rate: No requests' in large grey, a full-width Request flow card holding 1 line, and then the quota chart. No problems or needs-attention summary is shown.
top_fixes.user_impact: An operator opening the console gets no single answer to 'is anything wrong?' and must read multiple tiles to learn the state.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Add a status strip first (connection, credentials needing attention, quota soonest at risk). Collapse empty Request flow into the KPI row as an empty-state line. Label the 129 as 'since restart' next to the scoped 0 so the two numbers do not appear to conflict.

top_fixes.evidence: 2 amber banners with different borders, icons and layouts are stacked on Plugin Store. Plugins and Plugin Store repeat the same status line and toolbar.
top_fixes.user_impact: Visual noise above an empty registry. Warning severity is hard to rank when 2 styles mean the same thing.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Use one Alert component with severity variants. Merge the trust notice and the 'plugins.enabled is false' notice into one block, or make the trust notice a dismissible info callout.

top_fixes.evidence: Section tabs, provider pill tabs, status segmented control and 'View options' stack in 3 rows. 6 black 'on' toggles dominate the table. The bottom 'OAuth model rules' card duplicates the section tabs.
top_fixes.user_impact: Filters outweigh the credential data. The heavy toggles draw the eye before identity and status.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Merge provider and status filters into one toolbar row (provider select or chips plus status segmented control). Use a lighter or accent-tinted toggle 'on' state. Remove or shrink the duplicate rules card to a single summary line.

top_fixes.evidence: 3 product names ('CLI Proxy API', 'CLI Proxy API Management Center', 'CPAMC / CLI Proxy API Console'). Mixed 24h '19:20–22:40' and 12h '10:32 PM' on Dashboard.
top_fixes.user_impact: Small trust and consistency cost. Time comparisons across cards need mental conversion.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Pick one product name and one short form. Format all times through one locale-aware formatter.

top_fixes.evidence: Titles in the Config toggle grid are misaligned within rows. 'Keep original' is oversized. Disclosure triangles come in 2 sizes. 'API Keys List (api-keys)' exposes a YAML key in a title.
top_fixes.user_impact: Small polish defects that read as unfinished on otherwise tidy screens.
top_fixes.concrete_fix: Top-align card content in grid rows, use the field-label style for inline switch labels, standardise one disclosure component, and show YAML keys as secondary mono text.

strengths: Wayfinding: grouped sidebar with a clear active state, breadcrumbs, mobile back links for sub-pages, and Quick Start steps that link straight to destinations.
Disciplined mono/sans separation for IDs, keys, versions and logs. Usage tables and log rows scan well.
Dark mode is consistent across Dashboard, Providers, Quota and Config, with no broken surfaces observed.
Mobile adapts structure rather than just shrinking it: tabs become selects, tables become cards, KPI tiles become a 2x2 grid.
Honest data states: 'Not reported', 'Not checked', '4 of 4 eligible measured · 2 skipped', explicit timezone, and chart fallbacks ('How to read this chart', 'View data table').
The destructive action ('Clear login data') is visually distinct, and status is shown with text plus a dot, not colour alone.
unverified: Hover, focus and tooltips on the icon-only top-bar buttons (refresh, language, theme, logout) and on the per-row quota refresh icon.
Actual touch-target sizes. All sizes are estimated from pixels.
Contents and behaviour of the Actions menus, 'View options', 'Structured filters', 'Options', and the quota 'Not checked ⌄' dropdown.
Whether the theme icon toggles the theme or opens a menu, and what the sun/moon state means.
Chart interactivity (hover tooltips, data table contents) and how the chart looks when series diverge (the fixture has all 4 at 62%).
Keyboard order, focus management, screen-reader names, reduced-motion behaviour.
Full-page content below the viewport on every screen.
Populated Plugins and Plugin Store lists, Usage daily charts, and real request-flow data (fixture limits).
Error, loading and validation states, including OAuth editor validation after a provider is chosen.
